@damdo: This pull request explicitly references no jira issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-api-provider-vsphere/pull/106):

>Bumps `manifests-gen` to include webhook namespace scoping, which adds a `namespaceSelector` to all provider webhooks restricting them to the `openshift-cluster-api` namespace.
>
>This prevents webhooks from intercepting requests in other namespaces, which would fail on unsupported platforms where the webhook server is not running.


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Fcluster-api-provider-vsphere).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

## Walkthrough Two independent changes: webhook configurations are scoped to the `openshift-cluster-api` namespace via `namespaceSelector` additions; the `manifests-gen` dependency in go.mod is updated to a newer version. ## Changes **Webhook Namespace Scoping** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Webhook Configuration**
`openshift/capi-operator-manifests/default/manifests.yaml`|Eight MutatingWebhookConfiguration entries each receive a new `namespaceSelector` with `matchLabels` matching `openshift-cluster-api` to restrict webhook processing to that namespace.| **Dependency Version Bump** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Dependency Update**
